name: untested-new-auth-logic
description: A PR adds a new exported authorization function with real branching (role + ownership checks) and ships no test for it. This is the narrow must-test case the coverage sentinel targets: critical-path logic with a missing test, which should raise the risk floor — as opposed to the many low-risk PRs that legitimately add no tests.

pr.title: Add resource-level access control
pr.body: Adds canAccessResource() to gate resource reads by role and ownership.
pr.author: alice
pr.head: feat/access-control

expectedFinding.summary: New authorization logic in canAccessResource() ships with no test covering the role/ownership/visibility branches; a regression here would silently grant or deny access. Critical-path → raises the coverage floor.
